jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager - Spotify Technology
jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments. As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Product Security
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Security engineers at Spotify help protect our environment and more than 700 million users. Within Platform, our Product Security team evaluates and communicates Spotify's security posture, helping developers and leadership make informed decisions about security risks. We own the vulnerability management platform, supporting the full lifecycle of identifying, attributing, remediating, and reporting security vulnerabilities. As AI changes how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited, we're evolving how Spotify responds. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help transform vulnerability findings into reliable, actionable code improvements using agentic AI. You'll build the tools, workflows, and evaluation frameworks that make automated remediation more effective, scalable, and safe, while helping developers focus on building great experiences for our users.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it. As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: The Subscriptions Mission builds and scales the products, platforms, and business models that turn free listeners into lifelong Premium subscribers. We focus on attracting new subscribers, improving conversion and retention, and creating seamless commerce experiences that support Spotify's growth and bring fans closer to the creators they love. At Spotify, subscription data helps shape the decisions and experiences behind our 700M+ monthly active users and 290M+ Premium subscribers. You'll join a collaborative team building the backend systems that power merchandising, personalized experiences, and subscription journeys at a global scale. Your work will help listeners discover the value of Premium and give them more reasons to stay.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Free and Premium Conversion
jobs.description_text: Hundreds of millions of people come to Spotify to listen for free. Our ambition is to make that experience great while helping listeners discover the value of Premium. Getting that balance right is one of the most important opportunities for Spotify's continued growth. The Freemium Funnel team shapes the journey from Free listening to Premium subscription and beyond. We bring together Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Research, and Marketing to understand what listeners value, remove barriers to conversion, and create experiences that make Premium a compelling choice. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Free and Conversion Surfaces team. You'll shape how listeners engage with Spotify Free, discover Premium, make the decision to subscribe, and experience their first moments as paying subscribers. From Premium education to conversion experiences and early retention, you'll work on meaningful product challenges that directly influence Spotify's growth. This is an opportunity to think strategically, build at scale, and turn complex challenges into simple, engaging experiences that work for both our listeners and our business.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Spotify Connect

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to make Spotify easier to enjoy across the devices people use every day. You will work in Seamless within Platform & Partner Experience, focusing on Spotify Connect and the experiences that help people find, choose, and control where Spotify plays. You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager — Subscriptions (Freemium)
jobs.description_text: Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on helping listeners discover, experience, and unlock the full value of Spotify through awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape the future of Spotify's Freemium experience. You'll lead product initiatives that make Premium more compelling, improve the journey from Free to Paid, and create experiences that reflect the needs of local audiences. Working closely with engineering, design, data science, research, marketing, and regional teams, you'll turn consumer insights into meaningful product experiences that drive sustainable subscriber growth.

jobs.description_text: The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale. The Artist & Label Partnerships team (ALP) is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels and distributors across Sweden. We're looking for a Studio & Project Manager to make our Stockholm studio a place where artists, labels and fans connect, turning the stories behind artists and releases into sessions, video and formats that reach the next generation of listeners. You'll lead the studio and its projects with support from the wider ALP team, and project manage selected ALP initiatives so key partners see Spotify as their number one partner.

jobs.title: Tax Manager - Transfer Pricing [Analytics, Models & AI]
jobs.description_text: We’re looking for a Tax Manager to join Spotify’s Global Transfer Pricing team, reporting to the Director of Global Transfer Pricing. In this role you’ll focus on analytics, modelling and AI. You’ll drive the development of Spotify’s global transfer pricing models and economic analyses, keeping our intercompany pricing accurate, efficient and defensible in every jurisdiction where we operate. You’ll also help lead the team’s use of AI tools and automation to change how transfer pricing work gets done, from forecasting and projections to audit support. You’ll join a team of skilled, dedicated colleagues in a fast-moving international company, with plenty of room to take on responsibility. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

jobs.title: Index Analyst Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: About Syntax Data Syntax LLC is a financial data and technology company that codifies business models into a relational system we call Affinity Data™. Syntax operates through three segments: Affinity Data™, Syntax Direct™, and Syntax Indices™. Using its patented FIS® technology inspired by systems sciences, the Affinity Data™ segment offers comprehensive, granular product-line revenue data. Syntax Direct™ uses this data to facilitate the creation and ongoing management of direct indexing solutions and rules-based equity portfolios through an automated platform. Syntax Indices™ offers customized and proprietary indices, including core global benchmarks, thematic, smart beta, defined outcome, and target volatility indices. These indices serve as the foundation for a range of financial products, including ETFs, UITs, and structured products. About the Role The Index Intern will support our team by assisting with the research, creation, and development of market indices.

It's a chance to bring deep pharma marketing editorial expertise into a fast-moving SaaS/tech environment at the center of how the industry is reinventing patient and HCP engagement.

jobs.description_text: The Role To help our customers improve their data quality, we are looking for an experienced QA Engineer to deliver high-value features for Veeva Network MDM. If you are ready to make an impact and take your career to the next level, we want to hear from you! As a key member of our Quality Assurance team, you will drive quality across complex, cutting-edge systems. In this hands-on role, you will play a vital part in ensuring customer success with every release. We are looking for someone proactive, self-motivated, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

jobs.title: Senior Regulatory Domain Expert - Falcon
jobs.description_text: The Role We are seeking an experienced regulatory operations professional to serve as our Senior Regulatory Domain Expert for Veeva Falcon. If you are a process-driven optimizer who is frustrated by the manual data-entry, repetitive checking, and data-chasing inherent in traditional Regulatory Information Management (RIM), this is your opportunity to help design a tech-forward solution. You will bring your deep knowledge of global submission lifecycles and health authority data standards to bear, advising our product and engineering teams as they build next-generation automation tools. Actively partnering with early adopter companies, you will serve as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to replace legacy manual processes with intelligent digital labor.

jobs.description_text: The Role We are looking for a Fullstack Sr. Software Engineer who is energized by building a new agent first CRM platform from 0 to 1. You will have a high degree of ownership over the entire stack: from crafting responsive, component-driven interfaces in React to architecting robust, scalable backend logic in Rust. We need a builder who enjoys the challenge of creating a clean, scalable application from the ground up.

jobs.title: Services Engagement Manager - ClinData
jobs.description_text: The Role The Services Engagement Manager (SEM) is responsible for setting our customers up for success and representing the entire value proposition and effort behind a Veeva ClinData Implementation. This is a critical role in ensuring successful customer engagements during the scoping and planning phase to establish the right strategy for implementation success. The SEM is an integral part of the sales cycle, acting as a solution expert working in close alignment with the Veeva Sales, Strategy, and Services Teams. Utilizing their own clinical trial systems experience and Veeva product knowledge, they will structure the right solution, set the right expectations, and identify the appropriate project charter, including staffing, timeframes, and associated costs. Delivery of Proposals and Statements of Work (SOW) is a key deliverable from the SEM, along with potential implementation partner recommendations and strategic alignment of the team prior to project start.

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test

This is a hands-on position playing a vital role in ensuring customer success with each new release. If you are an experienced Quality Engineering professional ready to make an impact and take your career to the next level, we want to hear from you. In our fast-paced environment, you'll be involved in the product development process, taking pride in building great software. You'll collaborate with like-minded engineers in a high-energy setting and leverage your existing skills to learn and grow with us.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant
jobs.description_text: The Role As a Solution Consultant at Veeva Japan, you will understand the business challenges of pharmaceutical companies across Commercial (sales and marketing) and Medical functions and propose optimal solutions using Veeva cloud applications. Working closely with our go-to-market teams, you will lead customer proposals, product demonstrations, proofs of concept (PoCs), and RFI/RFP responses to support customer decision-making and win new business.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant - Medical
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva’s Solution Consultants are an integral part of our sales team, supporting our Strategists and Account Partners as technical product experts in the sales cycle, proving both the fit and value of our products to our customers. You will work closely with our Strategy, Sales, Product Management, and Consulting teams to sell Veeva Vault, our cloud-based content and data management software. Vault Medical applications (MedComms, MedInquiry, Publications, and Grants) are used by pharmaceutical companies to manage Medical Content, Respond to Medical Information Requests, Manage Publications, and Grants.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant - Site Solutions
jobs.location_raw: North Carolina - Raleigh · Wisconsin - Madison · Massachusetts - Boston
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. Join our Site Solutions team as a Solution Consultant and use your clinical operations expertise to transform how clinical trials are executed across the industry. We are looking for a driven self-starter who understands clinical research operations —someone who understands the day-to-day realities of running trials at a site, sponsor, or CRO and is ready to help the industry operate more effectively. This role goes well beyond delivering standard software demonstrations. You will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Strategy to uncover real operational pain points, challenge the status quo, and shape both how we engage customers and how our cloud applications evolve. In this fast-paced environment, you will engage with diverse stakeholders—from clinical research coordinators and site directors to IT leaders and C-suite executives. Success requires strong situational judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to quickly identify, articulate, and demonstrate the specific business value that resonates with each audience.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant - Veeva QualityOne - India
jobs.description_text: The Role As part of our regional expansion in our Veeva QualityOne business, Veeva is currently looking for a Solution Consultant who has a passion for helping our customers in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), Food & Beverage, and related consumer industries achieve their business vision for excellence in Quality Management. As a key member of the Solution Consulting team, you will be responsible for working with our Account Partners to understand customers’ business challenges & needs, driving technical win strategies, and providing deep solution expertise including value-based product demonstrations of the Veeva Quality application suite. Your contribution will be critical in driving technical sales execution to support the Veeva QualityOne Asia team as we scale our market presence across India and the region. At Veeva, we offer excellent opportunities for our people to capitalize on their skills and grow in a fast-paced, unique and exceptional work environment.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Ad Infra (Lyft Ads)
jobs.description_text: Lyft Ads is building the largest mobility media network. Brands use Lyft Ads to reach riders throughout their journeys, in the Lyft app, in the real world, and across the open web. Every time a rider opens the app, our systems decide in milliseconds which message they see, whether it’s a paid ad, an incentive, or a product message from another Lyft team. The Ad Decisioning team owns that choice. We run the serving, pacing, and auction systems behind every ad on Lyft surfaces, and we are building a first-party decisioning platform that lets paid and unpaid messages compete in a single auction based on their value to riders, advertisers, and Lyft. This platform is shared infrastructure. Ads and other teams will all use it to reach riders and drivers across multiple apps and surfaces. The work spans real-time distributed systems, auction design, and close partnership with teams across Lyft that message riders and drivers. We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead this team. You will spend a meaningful share of your time on technical work: shaping architecture, reviewing designs and code, and building with AI tools alongside your engineers. You will report to the Engineering Manager for Ads Infrastructure and partner closely with Product, Data Science, and a Staff engineer who leads the platform’s technical direction. jobs.description_text: The Marketplace organization at Lyft is responsible for accelerating the growth of the business while delivering on key business and financial metrics, and Pricing sits at the heart of it. The Dynamic Pricing & Offer Selection team uses real-time and historical data to set the price of every ride on Lyft, balancing price and ETA so riders have a great experience and drivers have earning opportunities when and where demand is highest. We also decide which ride options a rider sees, which makes our systems one of the highest-traffic, most business-critical services at the company. Engineers and scientists work side by side to take machine learning and optimization models from research to production while scaling our systems to handle more volume. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, operations and partnership leaders, and present your recommendations to senior leadership and AV partners.
